title: Safety-critical tracking control of a proportional-valve-driven asymmetric hydraulic cylinder via RBF-MPC-CBF
rights: CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ (DataCite rightsList). New summaries with attribution; original CSVs remain at Mendeley Data.
evidence_level: All three original experimental CSVs and depositor README downloaded and file digests verified against the publisher listing.

search_log.screening: Selected physical displacement and applied control voltage on a known command grid, with documented voltage, stroke endpoints and timings.

apparatus: 20 kg load, 1.5 MPa supply, 20 ms sample grid, calibrated magnetostrictive position; three separate controller traces per experiment. Source README describes exported final post-compensation/post-limit valve voltage.
derived: 9 controller-by-experiment rows. Episodes are contiguous samples within 1e-9 V of ±6.5 V. Both 104.4 and 105 mm comparisons are pointwise numeric reference counts; the physical/software interpretation is explicitly documented for experiment 2. Published error and margin fields are checked where available.
observations: Exp2 commanded 30 to 109 mm with 105 mm stored physical boundary. For PSO-PID, MPC-RBF, and RBF-MPC-CBF, respectively: +6.5 V at 51, 44, and 19 samples; peak measured travel 109.097, 109.023, and 104.863 mm.
Exp3: CBF position exceeded 105 mm in four samples (max 105.042 mm). MPC-RBF and RBF-MPC-CBF compute times exceeded 20 ms in 290 and 109 samples; PID timing is a zero placeholder.
limits: Applied voltage is the software-logged final output, with no synchronized pre-limit voltage request, coil-current sensor or valve spool measurement. Experiment 1 lacks voltage columns.

Comparisons use separately collected runs. A pointwise numeric threshold in another trajectory and computation-only durations do not establish the same physical boundary policy or end-to-end deadline misses. File accessibility does not establish peer review.
reproduce: Place the four input_files under INPUT with the listed names. Run python derive_asymmetric.py INPUT OUT (NumPy/pandas). Outputs: asymmetric-controller-traces.csv and asymmetric-voltage-plateaus.csv.

keys: Safety-critical tracking control of a proportional-valve-driven asymmetric hydraulic cylinder via RBF-MPC-CBF
